periods.analysis: We need to choose a team we will have a strong continuous relationship with after this project if we don't want to manage updating the website on our own after it is changed.
periods.recommendations:
Research and Shortlist: Identify design teams with a strong portfolio in aviation and proven expertise in website maintenance. 
 
 
 Assess Reputation: Check client reviews and case studies to evaluate their long-term partnership success with past clients. 
 
 
 Conduct Interviews: Discuss your needs and gauge their willingness and capability to handle ongoing updates and support post-project.
